Great question, Eric.

The main reason I focus on trading my system instead of long-term investing is simple: price only moves when other market participants step in with real money.

It doesn’t matter how undervalued a stock is on paper—if no one’s buying, it’s not going anywhere.

Take $TSLA for example. Over the last four years, the stock has barely moved if you just bought and held. But if you traded the swings based on our system, you could’ve captured significant gains every time real momentum came in.

It’s not about being right. It’s about timing when others decide to move the market.
